isNone().x: The value to test, of any type.

orElse().x: The value to use when it is present.
orElse().fallback: The value to use when `x` is absent. It must be the same type as `x`.

toBool().x: The condition to make definite: `none` becomes `false`, and `true` and `false` stay as they are. A number is not accepted.

toNumber().s: The text to read a number from, such as a value typed into a text input. Text that is not a number gives `none`.

text().x: The value to write as text, of any type. In the form with `decimals` it must be a number.
text().decimals: How many digits to write after the point, exactly, rounding halves away from zero. A whole number.
